rationale: Re-reviewed compiler-convert after narrowing the config settings sent to the script sandbox: compiler/src/config.ts (fixed-shape settings such as sourceMap keep only their keys, user-keyed records must hold plain data, and concurrent files share one decode of a chain) and compiler/src/sandbox-route.ts (its type) only resolve config settings for sandboxed renders. convert-to-jess.ts is unchanged: the projection still comes only from context.pluginOf(document)?.jessFunctions?.() and passes unchanged to emitJess, no projection is built in the consumer, the owner is not imported, and the alternatives' anchor lines are unchanged.
